clue.text: Advocate return of knight in exchange

indicators.note: in places the turned title inside the word for swapping goods

parts.note: to barter is to exchange goods without money

indicators.note: return of asks for the title to be read backwards, coming back the other way

parts.note: a knight is addressed as Sir

explanation.surface: A lawyer pleads for a knight to be handed back in a prisoner swap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return of' turns SIR into RIS, which goes inside BARTER.
explanation.definitionFit: An advocate is a lawyer who pleads in court, which is the work of a counsel called to the Bar in England.

clue.text: Returnable money

indicators.note: returnable says the word reads the same when sent back the other way, letter by letter

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A deposit coin you can hand back at the shop.
explanation.walkthrough: The ANNA was a small coin of British India; the word reads the same both ways, so it can be 'returned' unchanged.
explanation.definitionFit: The anna was a coin of British India worth a sixteenth of a rupee, so it is a unit of currency.

clue.text: Criticised for being knocked over by a motor car

definitions.meaning: to run someone down is to disparage them

definitions.text: knocked over by a motor car
definitions.meaning: a pedestrian struck by a vehicle has been ...

explanation.surface: A pedestrian complains of being slated after being hit by a car.
explanation.definitionFit: To disparage someone and to hit them with a vehicle are both senses of the phrasal verb, here in its past tense.

clue.text: Plans for me to enter chess knockout

indicators.note: to enter signals that one piece goes inside the other
a knockout scrambles the word chess, as if its pieces were knocked about

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone arranges to take part in a chess knockout tournament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knockout' turns CHESS into SCHES, and 'to enter' puts ME inside it: SCHE-ME-S.
explanation.definitionFit: Schemes are plans or systematic arrangements for doing something.

clue.text: Reflection of one's own outspoken views

definitions.text: Reflection of one's own outspoken views

parts.words: Reflection of one's own outspoken views
parts.note: a sound bounced back off a cliff returns your own words spoken aloud, as if your opinions were reflected to you

explanation.surface: Someone hears their own loudly voiced opinions repeated back.
explanation.definitionFit: A reflected sound repeats the speaker's own words; an echo is also someone who merely repeats another's views.

clue.text: Instant reaction of lively slender monarch

parts.note: lively means quick, as in quick-witted
slender means thin
a monarch such as a king

explanation.surface: A slim, sprightly ruler responds immediately.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapid mental response, the ability to react without delay, is what the phrase describes.

clue.text: Getting on beyond Is and any number like 2,3,5,7, 11…

parts.note: past means beyond, as in past the church
the letter I stands for the number one, so several of them are ones
the listed numbers are primes, divisible only by themselves and one

explanation.surface: A maths puzzle lists Roman ones and the first few primes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is' is the plural of the letter I, the Roman numeral for one, so it gives ONES.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone getting on in years is ageing, no longer at the peak of their powers.

clue.text: Pep up demand for a house-warming suggestion

definitions.meaning: to increase the pressure of one's demands
literally, a suggestion to switch on the heating to warm the house

explanation.surface: A tip for warming the house is also a way to press harder.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to apply more pressure on someone; taken literally it means switching on the heating.

clue.text: Upsetting it thwarts plans in the fruit market

definitions.text: Upsetting it thwarts plans in the fruit market

parts.words: Upsetting it thwarts plans in the fruit market
parts.note: the idiom about spoiling plans by overturning a costermonger's barrow, read literally of a market stall

explanation.surface: Knocking over a barrow ruins everyone's arrangements at the fruit market.
explanation.definitionFit: To upset this barrow is the idiom for ruining a plan; literally it is a cart of fruit on sale.

clue.text: Renowned as tourists with cameras in position!

indicators.note: putting the letters in a new position rearranges them

explanation.surface: Visitors famous for carrying cameras, at the ready.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearranging CAMERAS IN gives the answer; the stereotype of the camera-toting visitor makes it nearly an &lit.
explanation.definitionFit: Visitors from the United States have a stereotyped reputation abroad as sightseers.

clue.text: A step taken with due deference

definitions.meaning: the Latin word used before a name to mean with respect to that person

explanation.surface: Someone walks forward respectfully.
explanation.definitionFit: A stride is a walking step; the Latin form means with all respect to someone, used when politely disagreeing.

clue.text: Belief expressed by the bitch

parts.note: a bitch is a female dog, so read as a dog's ma, while the whole names a fixed creed

explanation.surface: A female dog voices a firm conviction.
explanation.definitionFit: A firmly held belief or doctrine laid down as true; the word splits as a mother dog.

clue.text: Article in trite magazine

indicators.note: in shows the answer is tucked inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A piece of writing appears in a banal periodical.
explanation.definitionFit: An article in the sense of a single thing or a news report.

clue.text: Does it make the car engine cough violently?

definitions.text: Does it make the car engine cough violently?

parts.words: Does it make the car engine cough violently?
parts.note: the device that enriches fuel for cold starts in older cars, also a verb for gagging

explanation.surface: A driver asks what makes the motor splutter.
explanation.definitionFit: The valve on an old car's carburettor, and also to gag or cough violently.

clue.text: Indian dish Paul I cooked

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are prepared and mixed up

explanation.surface: Paul and I prepare a curry-house rice dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiced rice dish of South Asian cuisine.

clue.text: Understand the door is locked

definitions.meaning: the fastening bar of the door is engaged

explanation.surface: Someone realises the door is fastened.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to grasp an idea; literally it describes the door's catch being fastened.

clue.text: Top bowler

definitions.meaning: a cricket bowler who turns the ball

explanation.surface: The best bowler in the side.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a spin bowler makes the ball turn off the pitch; 'Top' reads as 'best' but is the toy.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's top is a toy that is spun; in cricket a slow bowler who turns the ball is so called.

clue.text: Poultry dressed smartly by Baker

parts.note: chic means stylishly dressed
Kenneth Baker, the British Conservative cabinet minister, known as Ken

explanation.surface: A baker in smart clothes deals with poultry.
explanation.walkthrough: Kenneth Baker was a prominent British cabinet minister of the 1980s.
explanation.definitionFit: Domestic fowl kept for meat and eggs are the commonest poultry.

clue.text: Crackpot normally cracked with crackers

parts.note: a slang word for a madman, read literally as a shell that is broken with nutcrackers

explanation.surface: An eccentric is usually broken down by mad people.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for an eccentric or mad person; literally the shell of a nut, opened with a cracker.

clue.text: Girl put in 1.01 or maybe the One Thousand Guineas

annotationWithheld.why: 'Girl put in 1.01 or maybe the One Thousand Guineas' (7): LASS goes inside C...IC, but 1.01 as held does not give C, I and C; probably OCR of a different numeral
annotationWithheld.clue: Girl put in 1.01 or maybe the One Thousand Guineas

clue.text: Monster bell depicted by eminent artist

parts.note: a chime is a bell or set of bells
RA, Royal Academician, a distinguished painter

explanation.surface: A great painter portrays a monstrous bell.
explanation.walkthrough: RA, Royal Academician, is a member of the Royal Academy of Arts in London.
explanation.definitionFit: The fire-breathing beast of Greek myth, part lion, goat and serpent.

clue.text: He should turn over many a new leaf

definitions.text: He should turn over many a new leaf

parts.words: He should turn over many a new leaf
parts.note: a dissolute man who ought to reform, and also a garden tool that gathers fallen leaves

explanation.surface: A man with much to repent ought to reform.
explanation.definitionFit: A libertine ought to reform; the garden tool also gathers and turns leaves.

clue.text: Get ready to streak and tear past the street

indicators.note: past places one piece after the other, beyond the street

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street
to rip is to tear

explanation.surface: A naked runner prepares and dashes along the road.
explanation.definitionFit: To streak is to run naked in public, so one must first undress.

clue.text: Metal club

definitions.meaning: a golf club with an angled metal head

explanation.surface: A metal club, a golf term.
explanation.definitionFit: Fe is a common metallic element; in golf a club with a metal head is so called.

clue.text: Notice a portent

definitions.meaning: a placard or board giving information
an omen of things to come

explanation.surface: A warning notice seen as an omen.
explanation.definitionFit: A posted notice is a signboard; an omen is a token of what is to come.

clue.text: Appear to observe a maiden

parts.note: to observe is to see
M is the cricket scorebook abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: To come into view in order to watch a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: A maiden in cricket is an over in which no runs are scored, recorded as M.
explanation.definitionFit: To appear and to seem both mean to give an impression of being.

clue.text: State conditions on which close friends meet

parts.note: to intimate is to state or make known
terms are conditions of an agreement

explanation.surface: Setting out the conditions under which intimates get together.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on such terms means having a close personal relationship, the footing of good friends.

clue.text: Where shot-guns are carried when prepared for war

definitions.meaning: the phrase for troops equipped and ready to fight

explanation.surface: Soldiers mobilised carry their guns tucked by their sides.
explanation.definitionFit: Troops standing armed and ready are so described; literally, beneath the armpits is where a gun may be carried.
